ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a part of the CA6140 lathe control circuit. The left side is marked with a 110 V power supply, and there is a fuse FU2 above; after FU2 it is connected to the vertical line on the right, node 2 goes downward through the contact area marked SB and SQ2, and node 3 continues downward to connect to the QF coil/component. The contact symbols near SB and SQ2 are drawn in the state where the contacts are not touching and the line is interrupted. Reasoning: In an electrical diagram, a contact drawn as not touching or open indicates that this contact is in an open-circuit state. Therefore, during normal operation, the normally closed contacts of the key switch SB and the position switch SQ2 are in the open state.
